verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes a public API reference and tutorials covering customers, transactions (createOrUpdate, createEphemeral, void, negation), certificates, address resolution, filings and product mappings. The docs also cover Bearer API-key auth, curl examples and documented 429/Retry-After rate limiting, and the reference is served as an OpenAPI YAML spec. The probe's 404s on openapi.json paths do not contradict this, since the cited spec lives at openapi.yaml. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end to end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
